job.title: Sr. Data Engineer
job.pay_full: $118,700 – $183,600 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments if applicable; may be eligible for bonus and equity

details.about: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, operating in more than 200 countries and territories. This senior data engineer builds and evolves the large-scale data platforms and services behind reporting, analytics and data products across Visa, and helps improve how data engineering is done across the organization.
duties: Design, build and optimize large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines and services
Develop solutions with Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive and cloud data platforms
Build reusable frameworks, shared platform services and automation for multiple teams
Automate deployment and add automated quality gates and validation
Strengthen data governance: lineage, metadata, access controls and monitoring
Troubleshoot complex performance and reliability issues in distributed data systems
Lead technical initiatives, mentor engineers and join architecture reviews
needs: 2+ years of relevant work experience and a bachelor's degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience
Hands-on enterprise-scale data platforms, pipelines or distributed processing
Spark/PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive or comparable big data technologies
Scalable data architecture; performance, reliability and data quality problems
Automating data engineering workflows, deployment pipelines, testing and quality controls
nice: Automated data quality and observability frameworks
Data governance capabilities such as lineage and metadata management
Exposure to generative AI in data engineering or analytics
details.benefits: Estimated salary $118,700 – $183,600 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments if applicable; pay varies with knowledge, skills, experience and location. The position may be eligible for bonus and equity. The benefits package it may be eligible for includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
